subject: Fix CI break issue due to serverTests merged issue (#218)
reason: The change is a one-line compile fix in src/server.c's internal test-harness path (`valkey-server test all`): it renames `serverTest`/`struct redisTest` to the correct identifiers `serverTests`/`struct serverTest` so the file compiles. This code only runs when the binary is invoked with the `test` argument to execute built-in unit tests, never during normal server operation, and the fix changes no command, replication, persistence or protocol behaviour — it only repairs a CI build break. There is nothing a fuzzer scenario against a running server could reach or exercise, so no scenario is need
